Meridian Flush Therapy is an advanced manual therapy that utilizes specialized grooved wooden sticks to apply precise pressure along the meridian channels on various parts of the body, including the neck, shoulders, back, and legs. This technique is designed to enhance the flow of energy, or Qi, along these channels, promoting better overall circulation and activating the lymphatic system simultaneously. As muscle fibres start to loosen and circulation improve, you’ll not only feel a comfortable release, but your body also accelerates its self-healing.
